name: Bounce house
placement: On flat grass with at least 1 m clear on every side, a blower behind and an outlet within reach; no overhead wires or branches. Height is approximate.
modeling: A floor box 3.96 x 3.96 x 0.3 m, four corner column cylinders to 2.4 m and low wall boxes 1.2 m high around three sides, a front entry gap with a ramp slab, a roof box or pair of turrets on top and a small blower box at the back.
